scope: Candidate inventory; normative component contracts remain in docs/specs. Status is per item, not overall readiness.

status_definitions.known: Recorded fact with evidence, not proof of execution
status_definitions.selected-but-unverified: Candidate decision, requirement or bounded local slice without integrated Linux validation
status_definitions.required-unimplemented: Required integration remains unimplemented or unaccepted
status_definitions.unknown: Value, proof or requirement has not yet been established

items.value: Exact Linux RAM size, extents, low-memory holes and reservations for image, page tables, boot_params, command line, initramfs, firmware tables and MMIO are not selected. Board 4 GiB is a Windows-oriented initial target, not a Linux reservation map.
items.next_check: Choose nonoverlapping ranges and validate against image init_size (0x044c1000) and E820

items.value: Reference CPUID physical 36 bits, linear 48 bits; current local walkers use physical36/canonical48. Full Linux execution profile remains unverified.
items.next_check: Ensure CPUID, physical map and walker agree in integrated boot

items.value: Reference od-x86-64-v1-neutral-v0.1 selects max basic leaf 1, one logical CPU and the declared features in CPU_CONTRACT; it is not the full executable CPU profile (the local CPUID DiagnosticV1 is narrower).
items.next_check: Audit required features and implement and test every advertised capability

items.value: Full MSR allowlist and reset/exception effects are open, including EFER, FS/GS base, syscall MSRs, APIC base and conditional startup probes. Local slices (CPU-owned IA32_APIC_BASE S4-25b, bounded SYSCALL state S4-20c, GS-base and EFER read fixtures) do not establish complete Linux support.
items.next_check: Inventory reachable accesses and verify integrated effects and faults

items.value: bzImage boot protocol 2.15, XLF_KERNEL_64; direct64 entry is +0x200 from the loaded protected-mode image (setup_sects=39). Handoff: Long64 paging, identity-map init_size, zero page and command line; RSI=boot_params; IF=0; flat GDT with CS=0x10 and DS/ES/SS=0x18.
items.next_check: Validate header, placement, memory mappings and registers at actual handoff

items.value: Entry requires CR0.PE/PG, CR4.PAE, EFER.LME/LMA, valid CR3 and coherent Long64 state; candidate four-level policy requires CR4.LA57=0 (with max CPUID leaf 1 the recovered source's LA57 request condition is false). Other exact control bits and the initial root are not yet fixed.
items.evidence: S4-00b protocol and conditional source trace; recovered pgtable_64.c rechecked in S4-00c
items.next_check: Define values, validate actual state and capture before entry

items.value: Protocol requires flat boot CS/DS descriptors and segments; exact GDT base/limit, IDT state and remaining segment values are not recorded as an observed snapshot. Bounded paged LGDT/LIDT/LTR and MOV DS/ES/FS/GS exist (S4-18a/b/c/d/e; S4-18c is the CS accessed-bit write during #PF delivery) but are not the Linux sequence.
items.evidence: S4-00b; Linux boot protocol; MACHINE_CONTRACT S4-18
items.next_check: Specify permitted initial table and segment state and capture handoff

items.value: No Linux loader handoff snapshot, executed branch trace or successful boot observed.
items.next_check: Capture CPU registers, tables, memory map and full serial trace

items.value: Four-level 4 KiB plus 2 MiB candidate; 1 GiB, LA57 and PCID excluded from current local opt-ins. Bounded slices: S4-10b RAM-only 2 MiB leaves; S4-12c CPU-owned CR3 handoff and S4-12d CR0.WP; S4-12e mixed 4 KiB/2 MiB CR3 quantum and S4-12f freestanding mixed-page probe; S4-14d–g invalidation and INVLPG/MOV CR3 handling in the mutable diagnostic session and S4-19d guest PTE repair. 2 MiB MMIO is not implemented. Old 4 KiB APIs retain their admission boundary.
items.evidence: MACHINE_CONTRACT S4-10b, S4-12c-f, S4-14d-g, S4-19d; S4-00b
items.next_check: Integrate real instruction forms, CR4 effects and invalidation; establish actual large-page requirements (including MMIO) with a runtime trace

items.value: Bounded opt-in slices exist for paged #PF/#DF delivery, guest PTE repair with INVLPG, paged IRETQ, CPL3 loads/stores, SYSCALL/SYSRETQ and CPL3 MOV CR0 (S4-19, S4-20). They are exact-form profiles, not the Linux exception, privilege or syscall paths.
items.next_check: Cover the Linux-required exception, privilege and syscall transitions and TSS/stack switching

items.value: Bounded opt-in single BSP xAPIC ID 0 at 0xFEE00000, 4 KiB window, physical36; fixed edge/level requests, TPR/PPR, CR8, IA32_APIC_BASE, SVR and EOI (S4-25). CPUID.APIC executable advertisement and APIC Version/discovery are not complete.
items.evidence: Stage 4 S4-00 APIC subprofile; S4-25a-d; MACHINE_CONTRACT
items.next_check: Complete Linux discovery and interrupt delivery contract and verify actual accesses

items.value: COM1 16550A-compatible target at I/O 0x3F8 IRQ4; bounded polling TX, byte PIO paths and a guest RX-to-echo profile exist (S4-24a-d). Complete UART/IRQ4 behavior and Linux console integration are unverified.
items.next_check: Verify required register behavior, serial capture and IRQ routing with the selected image

items.value: One IOAPIC and explicit routes are board targets. Bounded slices exist for a fixed-edge route, one level route with Remote IRR and atomic EOI (S4-26a/b), and pending-IRQ delivery to CPU entry, guest EOI/IRETQ, STI/HLT wake, ordinary APIC quantum and JIT/interpreter parity (S4-27). Linux IOAPIC discovery (MADT/MP tables), the real route set and delivery on an actual boot are unaccepted.
items.next_check: Define the Linux route set and validate discovery, delivery, EOI and guest handler on an actual boot

items.value: Caller-driven virtual clock with bounded RDTSC (S4-22), one-shot deadline queue (S4-23), and a Local APIC timer with one-shot and caller-driven periodic modes sharing the vCPU clock (S4-28a1/a2/a4; the HLT-wake slice S4-28a3 is implemented but still awaits independent review in the plan) exist as bounded local slices.
items.next_check: Run these devices under the selected Linux boot and trace their use

items.value: The Linux clocksource, TSC frequency discovery, APIC timer calibration source and any PIT/HPET/RTC requirement are not selected or verified.
items.evidence: VIRTUAL_BOARD interrupt and timer; S4-00 APIC subprofile
items.next_check: Select source and calibration, implement and trace Linux use

items.value: Board proposes one PCIe root/segment, static topology and ACPI MCFG; actual Linux-required devices, BARs, windows, routing and discovery are unresolved.
items.next_check: Determine required enumeration from selected boot and expose only implemented devices

items.value: Direct Linux boot can use boot data and, if required, data-only ACPI from the machine map; actual RSDP/XSDT/FADT/MADT/MCFG need and contents are not established. No UEFI execution is assumed for this entry.
items.evidence: VIRTUAL_BOARD platform tables; Stage 4 S4-31 / S4-37
items.owner: od-machine and firmware data / S4-31 / S4-37
items.next_check: Determine required discovery tables and generate consistent descriptions from one map

items.value: initramfs artifact/hash, command line, zero-page fields, E820 contents, loader placement, early userspace and any block device remain to be selected.
items.next_check: Select and hash initramfs, define command line and boot_params, validate placement

items.value: The Stage 4 success milestone is defined in S4-39/S4-40: reach CPL3 /init, complete the selected syscall/return path, emit the nonce, receive a timer interrupt, and continue user execution. No Linux boot, complete serial log, execution trace or reproducible runtime snapshot has been observed.
items.evidence: Stage 4 plan S4-39/S4-40; no runtime evidence in S4-00a/b/c
items.next_check: Execute the defined milestone and preserve image hashes, manifest, handoff state, serial log and trace
